tiers.title: Code-verified
tiers.provenance: Re-computed by this command from the repository and its history. Nothing here came from the bundle, so nothing here depends on the contributor.

sections.title: Commits in range
sections.statement: Read from `git log` over the range.

sections.title: Files changed
sections.statement: Read from `git diff --name-status` over the range. This is the set the mutation-derived tables below are scoped by.

sections.title: Evidence Anchors re-checked
sections.statement: Every anchor in the range's touched documents, re-verified by re-reading the cited file. A failure here is rendered, not gated: the gate is `nullius check`, which runs on its own.

sections.title: Oracle conservation
sections.statement: Whether anything that grades this project was deleted, skipped or weakened in the range, and whether a decision accounted for it.
sections.reason: not configured — this project declares no "oracles" key in nullius.config.json, so this run checked nothing. An unconfigured project and a project whose oracle held still are different facts; declare the glob that grades this project to tell them apart.

sections.title: Bundled journals re-validated
sections.statement: `witness validate` re-run over every journal reconstructed from the bundle, before any count was taken from it. This checks a bundle's internal consistency and never its completeness: a bundle with whole journals removed validates cleanly.

sections.title: Review probe
sections.statement: Whether a canary claim is planted in a document under review. The location is never printed — printing it answers the question the probe asks.
notes: No canary is registered for this repository.

tiers.title: Hook-attested
tiers.provenance: Emitted by the harness's own runtime hooks — the agent had no opportunity to decline to write them. Read from the bundle, after every bundled journal re-validated.

sections.title: Records attributed to the harness
sections.statement: How many records the validator's provenance partition put in this tier. Journal-wide: `provenance` has no path predicate, so scoping it by the range would mean re-partitioning records here, which is the one thing this renderer does not do.
sections.reason: tier breakdown not recorded — 'pr58-session' is version 0.2, and per-record attribution arrived at 0.6

sections.title: Dispatches
sections.statement: One row per agent. Journal-wide, not scoped by the range: a `dispatch` record carries no path to scope by.

sections.title: Dispatch outcomes
sections.statement: The validator's three terminal states, counted apart. `never reported` is the one a summary cannot surface on its own, because the missing record is missing.

sections.title: Review rounds
sections.statement: A round is a maximal set of dispatches starting within 120000 ms of the first, with at least two members. A lone dispatch is not a round.

sections.title: Files mutated in the range
sections.statement: Scoped by the range: this is a mutation-derived table, and mutation-derived tables and the flowchart are the only places scoping applies. The tier counts above are journal-wide.
notes: 4 mutation record(s) are present in the bundle and excluded here: their path is outside the range's changed files.

sections.title: Edit bursts
sections.statement: The in-range mutations between consecutive rounds or commits, grouped by path.

sections.title: Findings raised
sections.statement: `finding` records, counted by the validator. A finding carries no per-record origin: the recorder extracts it from the harness payload at the dispatch's terminal event, so the header's `hooks` is true of it.
sections.reason: ledger counts not recorded — 'pr58-session' is version 0.2, and the run ledger's counters arrived at 0.6

sections.title: Operator turns
sections.statement: `prompt` records — what the operator asked for. The one record in the journal the agent did not cause.
sections.reason: ledger counts not recorded — 'pr58-session' is version 0.2, and the run ledger's counters arrived at 0.6

sections.title: Model and tokens
sections.statement: Token usage the harness resolved for each dispatched agent, summed. Additive metadata no verdict reads.
sections.reason: no report record in the bundled journal(s) carries usage — the recorder writes token counts at journal version 0.6
